Test fonts. Used by tests and the headless build so text draws the same on any machine.
Not shipped in release builds.

CascadiaMono.ttf, CascadiaMonoItalic.ttf, CascadiaCode.ttf
  Cascadia Mono and Cascadia Code 2407.24, variable fonts from
  https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/releases/tag/v2407.24 (ttf/).
  SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright (c) 2019 - Present, Microsoft Corporation.
  See Cascadia-OFL.txt.

selawk.ttf, selawksb.ttf, selawkb.ttf
  Selawik 1.01 Regular, Semibold and Bold, Microsoft's open substitute for Segoe UI, from
  https://github.com/microsoft/Selawik/releases/tag/1.01.
  SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2015, Microsoft Corporation. See Selawik-OFL.txt.

Twemoji.Mozilla.ttf
  Twemoji Mozilla 0.7.0, a COLR (version 0) colour emoji font, from
  https://github.com/mozilla/twemoji-colr/releases/tag/v0.7.0.
  Emoji graphics by Twitter, Inc and other contributors (https://github.com/twitter/twemoji),
  licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Font build code
  by Mozilla under the Apache License 2.0. Not modified. See Twemoji-LICENSE.txt.
